column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-30 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. Phase 30 had no committed enumeration at all, so this
# file is the first authored opinion its gate is checked against.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the seeded mutant labels the run read from the committed mutant domain
#   checks    the check ids tools/bootstrap_coordinator_gate.py implements
# Every metric here is measured from evidence this run produced in its own bundle. The
# retired gate verified a `live-*` battery that no tool in the repository writes — it
# checked whatever an earlier run had left under the plan tree, which certifies whoever
# wrote those files last rather than anything about this run. Those files are no longer
# inputs, and the three surfaces they used to stand behind carry UNVERIFIED metrics.
# `split-runtime-boundary` and `m6-swap-runtime-roots` are the same gap seen twice. M6 swaps
# the nodefs identity into the snapshot role, which is only detectable where the two roles
# have different identities — the SplitRuntime layout. The pristine guest prepares Unified
# backing, where all three roles share one filesystem and the swap is invisible. Reporting
# M6 red from a Unified run would be reporting a check that could not have failed.
